_comment: DOOR-ONLY SHOWS (DLR 2026-10-29). Paid events that sell ONLY at the venue's box office - no online seller exists, so the ticket-link check would drop them forever. Listed here they (1) stay on the site, (2) stay PAID (never 'free'), (3) read 'Check venue' and link to info_url (the venue's own programme page), (4) are skipped by verify_ticket_links.py and never removed by ticket_link_drops. Fields: match = act-name substring (accent/case-insensitive); venue = venue-name substring (REQUIRED in practice, so the same act name in another town is untouched); date = YYYY-MM-DD or empty for every date; info_url; why. REMOVE an entry the day a real online seller lists the show (then stamp it in verified_ticket_links.json). Entries are matched by name, so keep them specific.
